agent_definitions.purpose: Offline gate and sample-parity evidence; no edits
Own independent codec/container decoding and rigorous PCM tests
OS PCM adapters and hardware-format acceptance
Rust_Boy audio lease, bounded library and 1KiB interface
Stable roadmap IDs, evidence routing, docs and JSON index
Lossless policy and adversarial code/security review; no edits

gates.title: Ownership, standards and offline audit
gates.next_evidence: Offline dependency audit, fmt, Clippy, workspace tests, release build and macOS feature check pass locally on Rust 1.99.1; target hardware and host integration remain open

gates.title: Integer PCM core and explicit playback state
gates.next_evidence: Workspace tests pass, including lossless playback floor and fail-closed output state; actual device behavior remains unverified

gates.title: Native FLAC with CRC, Rice/LPC, PCM MD5
gates.next_evidence: Seven generated FLAC vectors and six private real-world files pass native PCM parity; broader codec and hardware evidence remains separate

gates.title: Mac AudioQueue / Linux kernel PCM output
gates.next_evidence: Source present; DAC format, drain and underrun measurement pending

gates.title: Expanded lossless umbrella
gates.next_evidence: Implemented AIFF is G10; ALAC and later formats are G11/G12 work

gates.title: Rust_Boy socket and shared audio-focus
gates.next_evidence: Unit slot and a Pip-Boy bridge contract exist; host-side adapter, worker scheduling, shared Radio/TV/Music arbitration and field acceptance are still unverified

gates.title: Strict RIFF/WAVE PCM and extensible WAV
gates.next_evidence: Six local native CLI PCM roundtrips and malformed RIFF rejection pass; hardware output remains unverified

gates.title: Six-file private FLAC differential corpus
gates.next_evidence: Six private tracks pass reference FLAC/FFmpeg parity and native Rust PCM SHA-256/byte-count parity; keep private audio out of Git

gates.title: Exact declared-frame timing and display progress
gates.next_evidence: Workspace tests and synthetic CLI PBM preview pass with a 1024-byte framebuffer; physical display and Rust_Boy button behavior remain unverified

gates.title: Audiophile-only admission and AIFF/AIFF-C
gates.next_evidence: Local offline gate passes on Rust 1.99.1/macOS and seven AIFF/AIFF-C native PCM vectors pass; physical DAC and host integration remain open

gates.title: ALAC decoder and M4A/CAF demultiplexers
gates.next_evidence: Raw ALAC 16/24/32-bit and nonzero stereo-matrix packet parity is independently verified; strict M4A/CAF demux and AAC rejection remain before format admission

gates.title: RF64 and WavPack lossless extensions
gates.next_evidence: Per-format independent parity and malicious-input rejection needed

gates.title: Bounded metadata and sample-accurate seek
gates.next_evidence: Never claim seek or album tags without indexed code and tests

gates.title: Windows WASAPI and Android AAudio ports
gates.next_evidence: Platform-local compile, focus and physical output acceptance needed

tasks.title: Rerun full offline Rust quality gate after formatter repair
tasks.acceptance: sh scripts/offline-gate.sh returns exit 0; record rustfmt, Clippy, all tests, release build and native macOS check
tasks.blocker: None for local RM-001 acceptance: sh scripts/offline-gate.sh exited 0 on Rust 1.99.1/macOS; physical device acceptance is tracked separately

tasks.title: Replay six private FLACs through native Rust decoder
tasks.acceptance: python3 scripts/test_flac_user_corpus.py --mode rust --require-complete "$PRIVATE_FLAC_DIRECTORY" passes 6/6 with independent PCM parity
tasks.blocker: None; all six supplied private FLACs passed combined reference and offline Rust metadata, inspection and full PCM parity on 2026-10-29; files remain outside Git

tasks.title: Prove native RIFF/WAVE decoded PCM roundtrip
tasks.acceptance: python3 scripts/test_wave_reference.py passes source-to-export PCM comparisons and malformed RIFF rejection
tasks.blocker: Native acceptance passed: six generated WAVE vectors were PCM-identical and malformed RIFF/padding cases were rejected; physical output is a separate gate

tasks.title: Verify lossless-only floor and focus denial through Rust_Boy
tasks.acceptance: cargo test --locked --offline --workspace proves below-16-bit/44.1k source cannot open sink or acquire lease; content-sniffing tests reject unsupported MP4/ID3/ADTS-like signatures independent of a .flac suffix
tasks.blocker: Local acceptance passed for the playback floor, mock-focus denial before output, and fail-closed signature handling; valid encoded lossy streams are not a supported codec corpus, and real Rust_Boy arbitration remains RM-006

tasks.title: Qualify macOS AudioQueue output with physical DAC
tasks.acceptance: Operator captures negotiated PCM format, rate/channel accuracy, drain/stop, device changes and loopback evidence; does not infer bit-perfect from CLI
tasks.blocker: RM-001 passed; physical audio hardware and measured DAC acceptance are still required

tasks.title: Integrate independent MUSIC socket with Radio and TV ownership
tasks.acceptance: Operator-run host integration demonstrates single focus owner across MUSIC/RADIO/TV and safe unload after errors
tasks.blocker: Pip-Boy has no Music package or verified MusicSlot/AudioFocus bridge; this goal permits read-only host inspection but not sibling-repository edits

tasks.title: Validate fixed 1KiB panel on actual Rust_Boy display
tasks.acceptance: 128x64 output renders correctly with physical controls, Settings and track/time clipping

tasks.title: Develop independent ALAC bitstream and PCM decoder
tasks.acceptance: New local ALAC crate handles predictor/entropy, bounded cookies, malformed input, exact 16/24/32-bit PCM parity; no third-party codec
tasks.blocker: Raw decoder acceptance passed: compressed 16/24/32-bit and nonzero stereo-matrix parity, all compressed byte-prefix truncations, malformed-cookie checks, and a full-packet bit-flip no-panic/bounds sweep. ALAC remains unadmitted until separate M4A/CAF demux tasks pass

tasks.title: Implement M4A/MP4 ALAC-only demux and AAC denial
tasks.acceptance: Strict ISO BMFF box bounds and ALAC stsd identification; reject AAC/DRM and wrong codec regardless of .m4a suffix
tasks.blocker: Raw decoder and independent 16/24/32-bit packet parity are complete; implement strict ISO BMFF demux and AAC/DRM rejection

tasks.title: Implement CAF ALAC and integer LPCM demux
tasks.acceptance: CAF descriptor, magic cookie, sample and chunk bounds verified with ALAC/PCM golden tests; no AudioToolbox decoder fallback
tasks.blocker: Raw decoder and independent packet parity are complete; implement bounded CAF ALAC/integer-PCM demux without OS codec fallback

tasks.title: Add bounded local metadata without cover-art memory spikes
tasks.acceptance: FLAC Vorbis comments and optional AIFF tags have deterministic size/UTF-8 tests; artwork never decoded into 1KiB UI
tasks.blocker: None; planned implementation must preserve strict memory/resource bounds and keep artwork out of the 1KiB UI

tasks.title: Implement validated sample-accurate FLAC seek
tasks.acceptance: Seektable and frame-boundary tests compare exact expected PCM frames; invalid seeks fail closed
tasks.blocker: None; RM-002 passed. Seeking remains unsupported until exact frame-boundary and invalid-seek tests pass

tasks.title: Implement RF64 large PCM files with ds64 limits
tasks.acceptance: RF64 large-size fields and metadata limits verified; legacy RIFF remains byte-correct
tasks.blocker: None; RM-003 passed. RF64 remains unsupported until ds64 bounds and large-file PCM parity pass

tasks.title: Implement WavPack only in verified lossless modes
tasks.acceptance: Own WavPack codec with independent parity; hybrid mode rejected without validated correction data
tasks.blocker: None; future support must reject lossy-only modes and pass independent parity without an external codec

tasks.title: Port native output to Windows and Android without codec dependencies
tasks.acceptance: Independent WASAPI/AAudio adapters pass target builds, local focus policy and device format/stop tests
tasks.blocker: Real Windows/Android devices required; macOS/host baselines first

tasks.title: Keep code, literature, agent roles and format registry indexed
tasks.acceptance: python3 scripts/check_roadmap_index.py and python3 scripts/check_literature.py pass offline without extra Python packages
tasks.blocker: None; roadmap, literature and format registries pass their offline consistency checks
